# One template per block; {k} is replaced by each word of words.txt.
=== binary bas
Sub Probe()
    x = a {k} b
End Sub
=== unaryfirst bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k} a
End Sub
=== trailing bas
Sub Probe()
    x = a {k}
End Sub
=== doubled bas
Sub Probe()
    x = a {k} {k} b
End Sub
=== afterminus bas
Sub Probe()
    x = a - {k} b
End Sub
=== beforeminus bas
Sub Probe()
    x = a {k} - b
End Sub
=== afternot bas
Sub Probe()
    x = a {k} Not b
End Sub
=== inparens bas
Sub Probe()
    x = ({k} a)
End Sub
=== inargs bas
Sub Probe()
    x = f(a {k} b, c)
End Sub
=== asarg bas
Sub Probe()
    f a, {k}
End Sub
=== instmt bas
Sub Probe()
    f {k} a
End Sub
=== condition bas
Sub Probe()
    If a {k} b Then c = 1
End Sub
=== plusprefix bas
Sub Probe()
    x = + {k} a
End Sub
